name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention: domain=field, descriptor=command_menu_loop. Accurately names the modal field-command menu loop (Save/Load, End Turn, Options, Suspend) that pops up on Space/Enter over an empty tile. No address residue; matches purpose and body.
purpose: Modal field command menu loop: pops up when the player presses Space/Enter on an empty tile, offering Save/Load, End Turn, Options, and Suspend, and dispatches the chosen action.
logic_summary: Copies the 16-byte options template (data_fd2_ui_field_command_menu_options_template @ 0x51E9F) and 16-byte state template (data_fd2_ui_field_command_menu_state_template @ 0x53EF2) into stack locals, zeroes data_fd2_ui_menu_cursor_idx, opens the slide-in settings dialog and loops fd2_settings_menu_input_step until it returns non-zero. Cancel (-1) returns 1. Otherwise dispatches on data_fd2_ui_menu_cursor_idx: (0) SAVE/LOAD/NEW GAME -> returns fd2_field_menu_status_save_load_quit_dispatch(); (1) END MY TURN -> loads leader portrait, shows 'End your turn?' dialog 0x1A1; if confirmed (typewriter result==1 and cursor idx==0) shows 'Turn ended' 0x1A2, delays 200ms, closes status screen, clears battle_anim_phase/play_active_flag, then for each active player char (flags&0x85==0 and team==2) pans cursor to its tile, finalizes its move via fd2_ai_walk_to_target_tile, dispatches any post-action consequence via the table, clears facing and marks acted; then composites frame, runs the full turn cycle, restores anim_phase/play_active_flag, returns 1; (2) OPTIONS -> fd2_game_options_menu_loop(); returns 0; (3) SUSPEND -> 'Suspend the game?' dialog 0x1A3; if confirmed shows 'Game suspended' 0x1A4 and runs the turn cycle, returns 1. Any sub-prompt cancellation shows the 'Aborted' dialog 0x19C, delays, closes, and returns 1.

returns.semantics: Result code consumed by the caller fd2_game_main_loop (which loops while 0 and maps 1->0): 1 = action handled / turn advanced / cancelled -> re-enter; 0 = nothing-to-do (e.g. Options closed); for cursor idx 0 the value is forwarded from fd2_field_menu_status_save_load_quit_dispatch (save/load/quit outcome).

notes: Source comment block (menu.c lines 27-49) is already accurate, concise, ASCII, and matches the decompilation across all four dispatch cases; kept as-is. Name is convention-compliant with no address residue; function is void (param_count=0; the in_stack_* and __CHK(0x54,...) artifacts are the Watcom stack-probe, not real parameters). Ghidra plate is more detailed than src but fully consistent (no contradiction), so plate left untouched per src-as-authority rule. All referenced globals verified against src/include/globals.h. The dialog post-prompt check '(dialog_result==1 && cursor_idx==0)' is the Yes/No selection (0=Yes) and matches the decompilation faithfully -- not a bug.
